googleCalendar.attendeesRequiresUp200Email: attendees requires up to 200 email entries with optional displayName/optional.
googleCalendar.chooseAllDayDateTimed: Choose an all-day date or a timed dateTime.
googleCalendar.chooseSendUpdates: Choose sendUpdates explicitly: all, externalOnly or none.
googleCalendar.datetimeRequiresExplicitTimezoneOffset: dateTime requires an explicit timezone offset.
googleCalendar.recurrenceMustArrayRfc5545Recurrence: recurrence must be an array of RFC5545 recurrence lines.
googleCalendar.supplyStartEndSettingRecurrence: Supply start and end when setting recurrence.
googleCalendar.supplyStartEndTogetherChanging: Supply start and end together when changing event times.
googleCalendar.textTooLong: {field} must be text of at most 16384 characters.
googleCalendar.useDateDatetimeOptionalTimezone: Use date or dateTime and optional timeZone.
googleCalendar.useMatchingDateTypesEnd: Use matching date types with end after start; all-day end is exclusive.
